page: Microsoft Azure E96-48as_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores running at a base clock frequency of 3.525 GHz with multithreading enabled. The CPU cache architecture comprises 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster. The system features 672.0 GB of memory, resulting in a high ratio of 14.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage includes 1443 GB of bundled local SSD capacity, while no discrete GPU accelerators are attached.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multithreaded compute throughput and robust memory capabilities. In multi-core tests, the instance scored 64915.93 in stress-ng and 16053.0 in Geekbench multi-core, complemented by an overall PassMark CPU score of 51926.65. Hardware cryptographic acceleration yields a PassMark encryption rating of 51487.59. Memory tests reflect a PassMark memory score of 2970.82 alongside uncached large-block read bandwidth of 106.17 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 59.74 GB/sec. Data processing speed is evidenced by multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rates reaching 214.33 GB/sec.

With a constrained core count relative to its memory size, this instance provides cost efficiency for software stacks licensed on a per-core basis that demand large memory footprints. The primary tradeoff lies in the absence of GPU acceleration, which results in poor performance during large language model text generation (2.28 tokens/sec on 70B models). The instance profile aligns with large-scale relational databases, in-memory key-value databases, big data batch processing, and memory-constrained enterprise analytics workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure E96-48as_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores operating at 3.525 GHz. Engineered for memory-heavy enterprise applications, it delivers 672.0 GB of system memory (14.0 GB per vCPU) alongside 1443 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Multithreaded compute and memory performance are strong, verified by a stress-ng multi-core score of 64915.93, a PassMark CPU rating of 51926.65, and a PassMark memory score of 2970.82. Dedicated encryption extensions facilitate rapid cryptographic processing, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 214.33 GB/sec. Because the instance lacks discrete GPU acceleration, deep learning inference on large language models remains limited. The configuration offers favorable efficiency for core-licensed enterprise software, making Azure E96-48as_v4 well suited for large relational databases, in-memory data grids, and large ETL data pipelines.
